newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail, Corpaf to break down pyramid.
newsitem.headline: Nail, Corpaf to break down pyramid.

text.p: New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) and Corporate Africa Ltd (Corpaf) said on Friday they were considering a restructuring involving:
- the creation and issue of Nail "N" (low voting) shares;
- the reduction of the share capital of Corpaf in return for a combination of Nail ordinary and N shares;

The removal of the Nail/Corpaf pyramid structure would increase flexibility in Nail's capital structure to pursue growth opportunities and realise the discount to underlying value at which Corpaf shares trade, the companies said.
The move was not related to Nail's involved in the black empowerment acquisition of control of Johnnies Industrtial Corp Ltd (Johnnic), a statement added.
